communication.setup.signal.intro: EYAS Signal ngaSbe'. wa'logh signal-cli (pagh REST ngech Hom) Dayu', ghIq cha' wuv neH naDev yIchel.
communication.setup.signal.step1: signal-cli yIchel (chovnatlh: brew install signal-cli) pagh Docker nuv bbernhard/signal-cli-rest-api MODE=json-rpc yIlo'.
communication.setup.signal.step2: bot mI' yIghItlh pagh yIra' (latlh mI' yIwIv, nIH Signal yIlo'Qo'): signal-cli link -n "EYAS" 'ej QR yIbej, pagh yIghItlh 'ej SMS yIchov.
communication.setup.signal.step3: HTTP API yItagh 'ej naDev 'Ij, chovnatlh: http://127.0.0.1:8080 (nIH daemon pagh ngech port lIng).
communication.setup.signal.step4: bIngDaq: bot ghoD mI' (qo') (+36…) 'ej tlham moQ URL (He Hutlh) yIghItlh.
communication.setup.signal.step5: jang EYAS ghoqwI' yIwIv, ghIq yItoD 'ej yIra'chuq. ghoDvo' bot mI' yIja'.
communication.setup.telegram.intro: Telegram @BotFather bot DIlbe' DaHech (wa' tup rIntaH).
communication.setup.telegram.step2: /newbot yIngeH, legh pong 'ej pong « bot » mo' yIwIv.
communication.setup.telegram.step3: BotFather HTTP API pegh mu' yIqaw (123456:ABC-DEF… rur).
communication.setup.telegram.step4: bIngDaq pegh mu' yIchel, jang EYAS ghoqwI' yIwIv, ghIq yItoD 'ej yIra'chuq.
communication.setup.telegram.step5: TelegramDaq botlIj yIja'. Qum → tay'Daq tay' ngoq yIlaj.
